text: Marks of the Valiant will be awarded to players after defeating mounted valiants for the following quests: *The Grand Melee (Alliance) *The Grand Melee (Horde)

.]] Marsh beasts, also spelled marshbeasts, are bog beast-like creatures native to Zangarmarsh. They have recently invaded Funggor Cavern, the home of the sporeloks, leading the Cenarion Expedition to send adventurers to intervene. The marsh beasts are led by Lord Klaq.
The Marsh tribe is a tribe of murlocs found in the Swamp of Sorrows. They may be led by Swamp Talker.
Marshal Ivalius was rescued out from the Broken Front by Argent Crusade agents. He is invalid and believes himself to be dying.
__NOTOC__ Marshal Magruder is a human located in Wintergrasp.
Marl Wormthorn is a worgen druid found at the Tainted Forest of Blasted Lands, and an old friend of Mayor Charlton Connisport.
Marksman Udabu is a jungle troll gunsmith located at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site in the Storm Peaks.

Marshal's Stand is a fortified base near the road leading from the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater. To the north is Fire Plume Ridge, a volcano in the center of the crater. After leaving Marshal's Refuge, Marshal Expeditions made their way here and built this small base, making sure they won't be run off so easily again. By the time of the end of the Fourth War, the camp was reinforced with sturdy walls and watchtowers. After the war, the base was visited by Zekhan and Rexxar.

Marshtide Watch is an Alliance port outpost north of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Alliance troops have amassed here following its establishment, intending to drive the Horde out of the Swamp of Sorrows by targeting their main outpost of Stonard. The outpost is made up of several cannon towers, stables and a blacksmith. As battle rages on in the nearby Bloodmire, some Marshtide forces can be found, along with their Horde counterparts, relaxing in the goblin town of Bogpaddle nearby.
Marsha Duchamp is a Forsaken food and drink vendor located at the Southpoint Gate in Hillsbrad Foothills. She was present during the Legion Invasions.
Marrowpetals are looted from Marrowpetal Stalks on the bottom of Stillwater Pond in Tirisfal Glades.
Marrowpetal Boots are a quest reward from Variety is the Spice of Death.
Marrowpetal Stalks are found on the bottom of Stillwater Pond in Tirisfal Glades.
__NOTOC__ Marogg is the quest giver for the Orgrimmar cooking dailies. He stands next to on the upper level of the Drag. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with an Orgrimmar Grunt.
Marker's Hauberk is a quest reward from Call in the Artillery.

Marshal Fallows offers daily quests for the Baradin's Wardens faction in Tol Barad. The NPC spawns randomly, rotated with Commander Stevens and 2nd Lieutenant Wansworth everytime the battle of Tol Barad ends and Alliance controls the area.
Marks of the World Tree are a currency used to unlock daily quest areas in the Regrowth of Mount Hyjal and the Molten Front in the Firelands.
__NOTOC__ Marsh Crocolisks are crocolisks found in southern Silverpine Forest.
Marksman Ye is a pandaren at Farwatch Overlook in Townlong Steppes.

Marksman Lann is a pandaren of the Shado-Pan located on the Terrace of Gurthan in the Dread Wastes. He is one of Bowmistress Li's best marksmen but got pulled down from the Serpent's Spine by a blast of webbing from one of the local spiders. After being found by adventurers, he tells them to investigate a mantid duel in a nearby cave while he heads back to the wall to report to Bowmistress Li. __NOTOC__
__NOTOC__ Marshtide Footman are humans stationed at Marshtide Watch. They are to Horde players at Bloodmire.
Marshtide Knights are humans stationed at Marshtide Watch. They are to Horde players at Bloodmire.
Marsh Lily can be found inside Dark Soil piles all over the Heartland of Valley of the Four Winds.
Marsh Fiddlers are crickets located in the Valley of the Four Winds.
The Mark of the Orca is created with Inscription (150); discovered through Research: Ink of the Sea.
Marshtide Invaders are humans attacking Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows during the last phase of the battle of Stonard. They fight against the Stonard Defenders.
Marshtide Peasants are Alliance humans chopping lumber to supply the nearby Marshtide Watch forces in the Swamp of Sorrows. They will not attack unless provoked.
Marshtide Mages are level 53-54 Alliance humans summoning knights to fight against the Horde in the Bloodmire in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Marshtide Carousers are Alliance troops of Marshtide Watch goofing off in the neutral goblin town of Bogpaddle in the Swamp of Sorrows. They are commonly found sleeping in the inn, chatting with Bogpaddle Workers, and watching Bogpaddle Entertainers at the bar alongside Stonard Carousers.
Marpi Greenwrench is a goblin herbalism vendor located at the Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Marlow Harston is a Forsaken located at the Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands.
__NOTOC__ Martang is an orc armor vendor located at the Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens. He was rescued by an adventurer during the Legion invasions.
Marnak is a titanic watcher located at Tribunal of Ages in the Halls of Stone.

The Marked Flawless Battle-Stone is rewarded for completing the Pet Battles achievement The Longest Day, awarded for completing every daily pet battle quest in a single daily reset period. Additional battle-stones may be purchased in exchange for from Master Li at the Celestial Court on Timeless Isle. Celestial Coins are awarded for completing the weekly The Celestial Tournament (quest) pet-battle scenario. Battle-stones may also be purchased for from the following vendors: Polished Pet Charms are primarily awarded from pet battle world quests and command table follower missions in Battle for Azeroth. Beyond that, three family-specific flawless battle-stones may be traded in for a marked bat

__NOTOC__ Martar the Not-So-Smart is a gnoll found patrolling in the open area to the north of The Arboretum in Jade Forest. He has a chance to drop Martar's Magnifying Glass, which summons him to aid you, as well almost any book of the Steamy Romance Novel series.
Martar's Magnifying Glass has an around 31% chance to drop from Martar the Not-So-Smart in Jade Forest.
Marri is a pandaren located at Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds.
Marsh Monstrosities are fungal giants found in the Amphitheater of Annihilation in Ashran.
Marshal Andrea DeSousa is a prisoner of the Horde in Ashran, found in Warspear Outpost. She can be freed.
Marsh Anacondas are snakes found throughout various locations in the northern .
Marsh Creatures are hostile mobs found in the Amphitheater of Annihilation in Ashran.
The Mark of the Khor is one of the random vendor trash drops from the Blingtron 5000 Gift Package.
Mark of the Kirin Tor had a chance of being looted from a Big Crate of Salvage.
Marmock the Wheezer is an orc located at the Broken Horn Village in Gorgrond.
Marrow is a Laughing Skull orc vendor and quest giver located at the Beastwatch in Gorgrond.
Marksman Aveua is a draenei located at in Talador before the enemies take over.
Marshwater Cape is created from Baleful Cloak when used by a: * hunter * rogue * Feral druid * Windwalker monk * Enhancement shaman
.]] The Market District is an area in the lower area of Highmaul that has been taken over by the pale, and where they summon Tectus.
Marrowden is a small field with a cave where Bahagar makes its lair in Val'sharah.

Marksman Redrick is a marksman found defending Sentinel Hill during the Legion Invasions. Despite having a unique name, he doesn't speak or doesn't seem involved in any scripted scene. He was presumably one of the Sentinel Hill Marksmen.
Marrowgore Collectors are wyrmtongues that appear alongside Gelthrog during the Legion Invasions.
Marnor Lorleaf is an Ancient druid located in Val'sharah. He is one of the elder disciples of Elothir and was being turned into a stone until rescued by the class leaders.
Marksopp the Tireless is a human death knight located in Acherus: The Ebon Hold, found wandering about the upper level.
Markus Hjolbruk is a vrykul innkeeper located at Jandvik in Suramar. After completing Turning the Tidemistress, Recipe: Koi-Scented Stormray (Rank 1) will be added to his inventory.
Martha Marion is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Mark of the Windrunner is a Marksmanship hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Called Shot (artifact trait), Deadly Aim and Healing Shell traits.
Marketplaces are neutral buildings that sell items to nearby heroes.
Marl's Stead is a farm located in Bradensbrook in Val'sharah. It's owned by Granny Marl, who is currently defending it from Lord Ravencrest's forces with the aid of her Stead Hands.

.]] .]] Marsuul are small creatures native to Argus. Most marsuul feed on fruit, but the Felclaw Marsuul prefers the juicy crunch of small rodents. They lay eggs and like to be petted behind the fins.
Marshal Expeditions Mercenaries are humans located in Marshal's Stand of Un'Goro Crater.
Marsuul Kits are marsuul located all over Eredath, sometimes surrounded by Flashfoot Marsuul.
Marshtide Marksmen are humans located in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Marsh Shamblers are mistlurker-like creatures located in Invasion Point: Naigtal. They become maddened by fel as the scenario progresses. Though it isn't seen in-game, some shamblers are fed and trained by members of an unknown race on Naigtal. Sergeant Krashj had a herd of shamblers which he would lead to the pits for combat, as part of a celebration called the Soltian festival.
Mark of the Triumvirate Warriors is a quest reward from The Seat of the Triumvirate: Armor of the Triumvirate.
Marten Webb is the apprentice of Master Ashton, an alchemist living in Falconhurst in Drustvar.
Marrowflies are ravager wasps located in Clearspring Pass in Tiragarde Sound.
Marked Apexis Windwraiths are arakkoa ghosts located in Ashran.
Marley's Seaweed Shop is located in Upton Borough in Boralus.
Mark of the Tideskipper is created by using Kul Tiran and Zandalari Inscription. It is taught by Technique: Glyph of the Tideskipper; dropped from Corrupted Tideskipper in Stormsong Valley.

Marshal M. Valentine is a human soldier of the Second War. Captain of the Pride of Tiragarde, he died when the Third Fleet was attacked by red dragons. He has a grave at Barrowknoll Cemetery. Years later, the Horde would look for his body by deep sea diving from the Horde ship The Banshee's Wail. They unpredictably found the body of Derek Proudmoore when finding Valentine. After that, Valentine was raised as a Forsaken and sent to Boralus as an emissary to inform Katherine Proudmoore that the Horde held the body of her son. When the Kul Tiran navy arrived to try and retrieve the body, General Cadarin held Valentine hostage, demanding that Nathanos Blightcaller relinquish Derek in exchange fo
Marshal's Regalia is provided as an objective for Everburning.
The Marrow Drained Bonestaff is a quest reward from Off With Her Head.
The Marshwarden's Vest is a quest reward from Corrosion Prevention.
Marrow's Sash drops from Captain Stef "Marrow" Quin in Vol'dun.
__NOTOC__ Marsh Lashers are lashers located in the Wetlands.
Marsh Flies are fireflies located in Darkwood Shoal in Vol'dun.
Marsh Snappers are turtles located in the marsh area (considered the Blackwald) in Gilneas during certain phases of the area.

__NOTOC__ Maroon Ink is created with Inscription (125); taught by Narv and Instructor Okanu in Nazjatar. It is also sold by inscription vendors in capital cities and has a small chance to be looted from Plundered Supplies.
Marsh Serpents are snakes located in Vir'naal River Delta in Uldum.
Market Dominance is a player vs. player achievement earned by completing 100 victories in Deepwind Gorge while controlling the Market base.
Marquis Pummeler is a venthyr located in the Desiccation in Revendreth.
Marko is a Zandalari troll whose skull can be found at the Head Shop in Dazar'alor.
Marrowroot Petals would be gathered with Herbalism. They could be combined to form a Marrowroot.
Market Collectors are brokers located at the Night Market in Revendreth.
Marrowblood is an Azerite trait available to Blood death knights.

Marrowjaw is a deathroc from the House of Constructs held captive by the House of the Chosen in the Unfallen's Sanctum in Maldraxxus. It is lying inside a large rune and starts off at half health. __NOTOC__
Marksman's Advantage is a conduit for hunters. It drops from Dessia the Decapitator in the Theater of Pain, Artificer Xy'mox in Castle Nathria, and the Eye of the Jailer in the Sanctum of Domination.
__NOTOC__ Marshal's Halberd is a quest reward from And Justice For All.
Marquis's Lace Cuffs is a quest reward from An Uneventful Stroll.

Marrow's Coppice is the southwestern portion of the Beastwarrens in the Maw. Bordered to the north by the Hungering Wastes, the northwest by Prodigum, and to the west by Ravener's Lament, the area has a mouth to Death's Howl and Death's Roar.

The Marlfur family of pandaren farmers lives in Stoneplow and tends to its fields in the Valley of the Four Winds. On Loon Mai's orders, adventurers of the Alliance and Horde were to evacuate them when the mantid invaded the area. Zhang Marlfur refused, however, as his grandfather knew what he was getting into when he first planted seed in the shadow of the Serpent's Spine. Ultimately, Zhang died and was buried next to his house, survived by his wife and four children.
Market Specialists are brokers located at Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Marrow Bursts are created with Shadowlands Alchemy (95); taught by Recipe: Marrow Burst.
__NOTOC__ Marrowbore Queens are ravager wasps located in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Marrowbore Feasters are ravager wasps located in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Marrowbore Creepers are ravager wasps located in Maldraxxus.
Martek's Stick of Truthiness are a quest reward from The Day that Deathwing Came: What Really Happened.
Mark of the Spider drops from Anub'ar Skirmisher, Anub'ar Warrior, Anub'ar Webspinner and Anub'ar Prime Guard in Azjol-Nerub.
Marshal's Ringmail Sabatons are sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 2 Mark of Honor.
Marshal's Ornamented Belt is sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 1 Mark of Honor.
Marshal's Ornamented Bracers are sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 1 Mark of Honor.
Marshal's Ornamented Greaves are sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 2 Mark of Honor.
Marshal's Ringmail Bracers are sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 1 Mark of Honor.
Marshal's Ringmail Girdle is sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 1 Mark of Honor.
Marrowfang's Reins summon Marrowfang, a flayedwing mount. The item drops from Nalthor the Rimebinder in the Necrotic Wake. It is also looted from Challenger's Cache.
__NOTOC__ Marsh Hornets are wasps located in Zul'Nazman and Xal'vor in Nazmir.
Mark of the Shimmering Ardenmoth is created with Inscription (100); taught by Droman Dawnblossom in Ardenweald.
Mark of the Sable Ardenmoth is created with Inscription (100); taught by Technique: Mark of the Sable Ardenmoth.
Mark of the Midnight Runestag is created with Inscription (100); taught by Technique: Mark of the Midnight Runestag.
Mark of the Regal Dredbat is created with Inscription (100); taught by Technique: Mark of the Regal Dredbat.
Mark of the Twilight Runestag is created with Inscription (100); taught by Technique: Mark of the Twilight Runestag.
__NOTOC__ Marrowgrub Nibblers are carrion grubs located at the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus.
Marootu is a tuskarr fish vendor located in Kauriq Gleamlet in the Azure Span.
Marshrock Threshalisks are basilisks located along the the northeastern edge of the Dead Mire in Zangarmarsh.
Marshrock Stompers are basilisks located along the the northeastern edge of the Dead Mire in Zangarmarsh.
Marmoni Rescue Pack is provided as an objective for Marmoni in Distress.
Marshtide Steeds are horses located in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Marmoni's Prize is an ingredient for the Observant Riddle "Treat".
Mark of the Provider drops from: *Shadepaw Trainer *Trained Hyena *Shadepaw Bruiser *Shadepaw Hunter *Scavenging Hyena *Shadepaw Skulker *Shadepaw Bandit
Marron Glassee is a niffen located in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern.
Mark of the Loamy Umbraclaw is obtained after attuning the Silent Mark of the Umbraclaw to enough umbraclaws.
Mark of the Lush Dreamstag is obtained after attuning the Silent Mark of the Dreamstag to enough dreamstags.
Mark of the Verdant Bristlebruin drops from Moragh the Slothful in a cave east of Whorlwing Basin in the Emerald Dream.
Mark of the Thriving Dreamtalon is obtained after attuning the Silent Mark of the Dreamtalon to enough dreamtalons.
Mark of the Keen-Eyed Dreamsaber drops from Keen-eyed Cian in the Viridescent Thicket in the Emerald Dream.
Mark of the Umbramane drops from Mosa Umbramane in the Emerald Dream.
Mark of the Slumbering Somnowl is created by combining a Somnowl Feather Strand with a tier 3 Runed Writhebark.
Marlene is a house cat located in the Wildling Garden in the Emerald Dream. Marlene can be petted.

A massively multiplayer online game (a.k.a. MMOG or simply MMO) is a type of computer game that enables hundreds or thousands of players to simultaneously interact in a game world they are connected to via the Internet. Typically, this kind of game is played in an online, multiplayer-only persistent world. World of Warcraft is an "MMORPG", a type of MMOG or MMO.

The Master's Glaive is located in the southwest part of Darkshore. It is a massive, adamantine glaive embedded in the skull of Soggoth the Slitherer, Herald of the Old Gods. Onu, the Ancient of Lore, said that an "old, old lord of the earth" fell here, and sent players to investigate.
Master Engineer's Goggles are cloth head armor that require 280 engineering to wear.
Massive Mojo is dropped from any of the normal bosses in Zul'Gurub, but most commonly from Hakkar. The sole use of Massive Mojo is creating Gurubashi Mojo Madness to begin the Edge of Madness event.
Martin Lindsey is a Forsaken Arathi Basin battlemaster located on the Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff during the monthly Call to Arms: Arathi Basin.
Master Gadrin is a an elderly jungle troll of the Darkspear tribe located in Sen'jin Village in Durotar. Bom'bay is his assistant.

Master Apothecary Lydon (promoted from Apothecary Lydon with the Cataclysm), is a member of the Royal Apothecary Society. Though dedicated to the Dark Lady and the advancement of the Forsaken, he suffers from severe depression. The only thing that cheers him up is the suffering of the living. He had a frog named Umpi whom he referred to as his "assistant" but treated with a lethal callousness. He is likely working closely with Apothecary Jorell at the Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands.

Marvon Rivetseeker is a goblin located at the Broken Pillar in Tanaris. He is a scientist and a treasure hunter, and has studied many ancient areas of the world. He studies the ancient areas of the world, and his workshop is located in the goblin town of Ratchet. He recently left the workshop in hands of his assistant and set off on an expedition in Tanaris, and was last seen heading south from Gadgetzan. Marvon's work on the pillar later became a subject of studies for archaeologists. He is friends with Larion and Fronkle. In the past, he entered the Sunken Temple and barely managed to find his way out. Before the Cataclysm, he was interested in Gahz'ridian ornaments to study. He also direc

__NOTOC__ Martine Tramblay is a Forsaken fishing vendor located in Death's Watch Waystation southeast of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Martine relocated to Brill after the Forsaken started rebuilding it. She is seen speaking with Clyde Kellen.
Mask of the Unforgiven is a Level 42 quality Leather Facemask that improves Stamina, Critical Strike and Haste.

__NOTOC__ Master Digger is a rare kobold that can be found in the innermost part of Jangolode Mine in Westfall. He is on a 1.5 - 2.5 hour respawn timer. He should be fought by level 10 and below players with caution. His real name, if any, is unknown.
Master Dragonslayer's Orb is a quest reward from The Lord of Blackrock (Alliance) (2) and The Lord of Blackrock (Horde) (2).
Master Dragonslayer's Medallion is a quest reward from: *The Lord of Blackrock (Alliance) (2) *The Lord of Blackrock (Horde) (2)
__NOTOC__ Marukai is a jungle troll quest giver located at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
.]] The Mass of McGowan is a world drop from level 58-63 monsters.
Masons Fraternity Ring is the reward for completing the quest Divino-matic Rod (quest) in Zul'Farrak. Many hunters and rogues are known to use this ring until reaching level 60 and beyond.
Masat T'andr is a Broken leatherworking vendor located at the Harborage in the Swamp of Sorrows.

The Master's Cellar is an area riddled with ghosts in the southernmost portion of the Deadwind Pass, just south of Karazhan. It is below the ruins of a small village, probably the former home of servants that worked in the nearby tower of Karazhan. Its lower section is called Lower Cellar. There are two separate entrances to the Master's Cellar. One leads into a vast wine cellar, filled to the brim with Unliving Residents, Unliving Caretakers, Damned Souls, Restless Shades, and Wailing Spectres. The other leads into a similar cellar, but here the floor has collapsed into a cave system leading deep underground. The second cellar and cave system are also filled with the same type of undead, bu
Master Dragonslayer's Ring is a quest reward from: *The Lord of Blackrock (Alliance) (2) *The Lord of Blackrock (Horde) (2)
Master Conjuror was a warlock talent in the Demonology tree.

The Mast Room lies beyond the second set of mines, and is where adventurers first encounter hobgoblins inside the Deadmines. It is Helix Gearbreaker's room and is where he and his crew order the "oafs" to mine and do all kinds of jobs for him. This lumber mill is a filthy place and is filled with rats. Before the Cataclysm, the Mast Room was filled with Goblin Woodcarvers and their boss Sneed.
__NOTOC__ Master Chef Mouldier is a blood elf cooking trainer and vendor located at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands.

Martin Thunder is an weapon which can rarely be linkable on certain realms. Quite uniquely, it has no weapon type so it can be wielded by any class. Given its description, the weapon is likely a weapon used by Blizzard for testing purposes. It is not accessible to regular players and has only appeared wielded by Game Masters in screenshots. Its graphic is almost exactly like that of the Argent Avenger from a Stratholme quest line and Spellfire Longsword from Slave Pens, but has some blue on the hilt. Since patch 3.3, the item is now called Martin's Broken Staff and has had its attributes changed. This page still exists for historical purposes.

__NOTOC__ Martik Tor'seldori is a blood elf quest giver located in Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula. He remains in Thrallmar directing blood elf pilgrims further along to the elven outpost, Falcon Watch, to the west. He is guarded by two Falcon Watch Sentinels.
Master First Aid - Doctor in the House could be purchased for from: * in Hellfire Peninsula * at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula
Martyrdom is a priest talent which provides spell pushback and interrupt resistance upon receipt of a critical strike.
Master Healthstones are created with a warlock's Create Healthstone (Rank 6) or Ritual of Souls (Rank 1) spell.
Master Hunter's Bow was a quest reward from Big Game Hunter.
Master Hunter's Rifle is a quest reward from Big Game Hunter.
Master Apothecary Cape is a quest reward from Return to Apothecary Zinge.

Marticar is a rare mob Spore Walker. He is faster than the average mob, and also has a lot of more health than them. He is immune to fear, slow, and immbolization effects. He hits for 900 on cloth wearers (with mitigation) and has an nature based attack which pulls a single player toward Marticar, himself.

__NOTOC__ Master Engineer Telonicus is one of the four blood elf advisors that aid Kael'thas during the boss encounter in the Eye. He appears to be a Hunter. It is possible that he oversaw the construction of Void Reaver and other construction from Mechanar.

__NOTOC__ Master Engineer Zinfizzlex is a goblin located at Winterax Hold in Alterac Valley. He can be found unconscious in front of the Winterax Cave. The first faction to reach him, has the option of escorting him to their base, in order for him to offer his services to his rescuers.

Masophet the Black is a skeletal mage and one of the four lieutenants of Dar'Khan Drathir, the master of Deatholme. He resides in one of two ziggurats - one near the slaughterhouse in eastern Deatholme, and the other near the slaughterhouse in southern Deatholme (usually near Borgoth the Bloodletter, in other words).

Marzon, if this is his real name, is an assassin currently employed by Lord Gregor Lescovar. Wearing the name Maelik, he built up relations with the Defias Brotherhood, and visited Bazil Thredd. After being exposed by Tyrion in Stormwind Keep, Marzon and Gregor were killed.
Master's Mantle drops from: * Nefarian in Blackwing Lair * Gahz'ranka in Zul'Gurub * Lord Kazzak in Blasted Lands * Onyxia in Onyxia's Lair * Highlord Kruul in Silithus
The Massacre Sword is a world drop from pre-Burning Crusade dungeons.
Master Fishing - The Art of Angling is purchased from Juno Dufrain near Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.
Mask of Introspection was an epic plate helm for holy paladins.

__NOTOC__ Master Daellis Dawnstrike is a blood elf located with other Sunfury bowmen west of Manaforge Duro in Netherstorm. On Prince Kael'thas' orders, Daellis led the attack against Kirin'Var Village. Custodian Dieworth wants Daellis dead. Dieworth mentions that Daellis wore a tabard "with a device I've never seen before"; the tabard actually being the Blood Knight Tabard. It is unknown why an archer like Daellis would be wearing a traditional Blood Knights armor and tabard.
The Master's Gloves drop from: * Nefarian in Blackwing Lair * Gahz'ranka in Zul'Gurub * Lord Kazzak in Blasted Lands * Onyxia in Onyxia's Lair * Highlord Kruul in Silithus
The Master's Hat drops from: * Nefarian in Blackwing Lair * Gahz'ranka in Zul'Gurub * Lord Kazzak in Blasted Lands * Onyxia in Onyxia's Lair * Highlord Kruul in Silithus

The Master's Terrace in Karazhan is the ledge running along the exterior side of the tower itself. Falling off the terrace will result in a quick death. Interesting to note is the view of Deadwind Pass from the terrace. While the view to the east is extremely similar to the actual zone, the view toward the west is significantly different. Specifically, the chapel, graveyard, and crypt are missing, and in their place is a valley between the rock walls that extends to the southwest, with another village located in that valley. Maruff Grandhorn is a tauren healer. He is the friend of of the high elf Leanine Starborn. He once agreed to let her use absorb mana on him to recover some of her energy. When Leanine finished casting the spell, she absorbed all of Maruff's unused mana.
The Mask of the Fury Hunter is an epic leather helm for feral druids.

The Mask of the Watcher can be looted from the Cache of Eregos after defeating Ley-Guardian Eregos in the Oculus on heroic mode.
This is an enchantment placed upon a tailor's leg items. No "Master's Spellthread" object exists. Sapphire Spellthread is a tradeable augment item that provides an equivalent enchantment.
The Massive Glowing Egg can be found in the Borean Tundra. It starts the quest Massive Moth Omelet?.
Master's Inscription of the Axe is an Inscription-only permanent enchant to shoulders.
Master's Inscription of the Crag is an Inscription-only permanent shoulder enchantment optimized for spell casters.
Master's Inscription of the Pinnacle is an Inscription-only permanent shoulder enchantment optimized for tanks.
Master's Inscription of the Storm is an Inscription-only permanent shoulder enchantment optimized for spell casters.
Mary Darrow is a Forsaken stable master located at New Agamand in the contested territory of Howling Fjord.

Martin Fury is a shirt that was formerly of quality before it was changed to its current status and removed from the World of Warcraft Armory database. Given its (original) description, the shirt is likely a weapon used by Game Masters for testing purposes. It is not accessible to regular players.
Master Angler of Azeroth is a Fishing achievement involving participation in the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza.
__NOTOC__ Mary Allerton is a human cooking trainer found in Darnassus during Pilgrim's Bounty.

Formerly Martin Thunder, Martin's Broken Staff is the name for the item since it was changed in Patch 3.3. Its appearance has not changed, but its quality was reduced to Poor, its spell effect changed to kill the wielder as opposed to enemies, and its sell price was reduced tenfold.

Master Forteski is a Forsaken quest giver located outside the Deep Elem Mine in Silverpine Forest. Having tracked the Bloodfang worgen here, he stands ready with a contingent of Veteran Forsaken Troopers, ready to crush the forces hiding inside. However, it seems this was a trap set up by Ivar Bloodfang and Forteski, thinking fast, saves the hero just before dying in an explosion.
Mary Oxworth is a worgen banker located throughout Gilneas. She is one of Krennan's patients.
The Mask of the Speaker is a quest reward from Slaves of the Firelord (Horde).
Maruut Stonebinder was a tauren shaman of the Earthen Ring, notably leading the forces holding the Temple of Earth in Deepholm where he perished.
__NOTOC__ Marvin Winters is a Forsaken mail armor vendor located at the Hiri'watha Research Station in the Hinterlands.
Master Crafter is a guild professions achievement obtained after crafting 500 Epic items.
Master Archaeologist is an achievement that requires the character to obtain 375 skill points in archaeology.
__NOTOC__ Master Klem is a human found in the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
Master Chef's Groceries drop from the Gurubashi Master Chef in Zul'Gurub.
Mass Entanglement is a druid class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Ursol's Vortex.

Master Aitokk is an orc quest giver formerly found in Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands. Aitokk fell during the Ironmarch attack on Nethergarde. His corpse was found in the ruins and his axe recovered.
Massive Jormungar is a jormungar captured by the vrykul and displayed in the Trophy Hall of Utgarde Pinnacle.
A large number of Master Archers can be found standing in front of in the archery range of the Scarlet Halls.
Master's Haversack is a quest reward from Only the Worthy Shall Pass.
__NOTOC__ Master Goh is a pandaren located at Silken Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Master Bruised Paw, known to most as the Hidden Master, is a legendary pandaren monk. He is a hermit living in the remote Paoquan Hollow in the Valley of the Four Winds and is willing to impart his special training and advice on anyone who can find him. After the adventurer and Lin Tenderpaw find him, he trains both of them in the form of several quests and two sports movie-style montages. He later takes part in defending Stoneplow from the mantid swarm.

Mason's Folly is east of the Tavern in the Mists on the Veiled Stair. Masons carefully carved a set of steps into a hill, but the steps lead to nothing in particular except for a striking vista. No one knows what the stairs' original purpose was, though given the name it is very likely that it is a section of the Path of a Hundred Steps that was chiseled the wrong direction. The Hammer of Folly can be found here.

Master Lao is the innkeeper at the Temple of the White Tiger in the Kun-Lai Summit. During the trial of Garrosh Hellscream, Lao, the monks, and Black Arrow were asked to stay away from the temple grounds during daytime.
Master Greenpaw is a pandaren statue found in the Lair of the Jade Witch in the Jade Forest.

Master Angler Ju Lien is a pandaren quest giver located on the shoreline west of Soggy's Gamble in the Dread Wastes. Adventurers are sent to help him with his fishing lines, but shortly after he ends up being kidnapped by the kraken Jiao. After Jiao is defeated, Ju Lien safely swims back to shore along with an unexpected find—a chunk of amber containing Ka'roz the Locust.
__NOTOC__ Masked Tanuki are raccoons found throughout the Jade Forest. They also appear in Snowblossom Village.
__NOTOC__ Masked Tanuki Pups are raccoons following Masked Tanukis in the Jade Forest.
Master Cannon is a jungle troll skinning and leatherworking trainer located in the sanctuary area of Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit.
Massive Fang can drop from any fanged beast mob in Pandaria, such as cats and wolves and the like.
Master Cranewing is a pandaren found in a house in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle.

Master Callers are Zandalari trolls found surrounding the Defiant Devilsaur and the Defiant Direhorn at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder. If no callers are alive, the defiant beast will break free and wreak havoc on the trolls in camp!
Marz Richards is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
The Master Control Pump is a goblin machine designed to dig up oil in Felwood. It controls the entire pipe line for oil.
Massive Anima Golem is a blood golem located in the Throne of Thunder.
__NOTOC__ Master Bier is a Forsaken first aid trainer located in the sanctuary area of Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit. He is standing next to Master Lo, watching him fish.
Master Lo is a gnome fishing trainer located in the sanctuary area of Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit. He is standing next to Master Bier, who is watching him fish.

__NOTOC__ Master Chang is a pandaren cooking trainer located in the sanctuary area of Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit. She also sells brews exclusively to monks. When the Burning Legion invaded the temple, she was seen healing the wounded Master Hwang.
Master Craftsman Wilhelm, originally Craftsman Wilhelm, is a dwarf blacksmithing vendor located at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is affiliated with the Brotherhood of the Light.
__NOTOC__ Master Liu is a pandaren found in the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Ms. Thai is apparently his daughter.
The Marvelous Mobile Murloc Manor Maker is provided as an objective for A New Home.
Master Brownstone is a pandaren located in A Little Patience scenario.
Master Li runs the Celestial Tournament from the Celestial Court on the Timeless Isle.
Master Kukuru is a hozen located in Kukuru's Grotto on the Timeless Isle.
The Mask of Anger is purchased from for at Friendly standing with Emperor Shaohao.
The Mask of Doubt is purchased from for at Friendly standing with Emperor Shaohao.
The Mask of Fear is purchased from for at Friendly standing with Emperor Shaohao.
The Mask of Hatred is purchased from for at Friendly standing with Emperor Shaohao.
The Mask of Violence is purchased from for at Friendly standing with Emperor Shaohao.
__NOTOC__ Master Cannoneer Dagryn is an orc of the Dragonmaw clan during the Galakras encounter in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Master Hwang is a pandaren found at the Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit. When the Burning Legion invaded the temple, Master Chang was healing the wounded Hwang.
__NOTOC__ Master Kistane is a pandaren monk found at the Training Grounds of the Peak of Serenity of Kun-Lai Summit. Her nearby Serpent Statues give her Soothing Mist.
__NOTOC__ Master Engineer Cogswing is a gnome located at the Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest. He's a mechanic specialized in gyrocopter upkeep.
Master Chow is a pandaren seen sparring with Master Yeoh on a gong frame at the Training Grounds of Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit.

:Discipline is not a war that is won. It is a battle, constantly fought. Master Feng is a pandaren of the Tushui philosophy. His scroll is found at Shang Xi Training Grounds. His current whereabouts are unknown.
Mashok is one of the dark shaman left behind by Garrosh Hellscream on Pandaria after the destruction of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Massive Ik'thik Kunchong are kunchong located in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Mary Kearie is a human quest giver and vendor located at Lunarfall's Alchemy Lab. For alchemists, she will sell new formulas. For non-alchemists, she will make items instead.
Maru'sa is a jungle troll vendor of inscription recipes in Warspear's troll district.

Maska is a tauren follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Master Draftsman is an achievement earned from learning 40 garrison blueprints.
Master Defender is an achievement rewarded from earning a Gold rating in each max-level garrison invasion.
Masked Chuckler is a title awarded for obtaining the achievement Laughing Skull Orcs (achievement). The title will show before the character's name, in the following format: :Masked Chuckler
Mary Elizabeth McGlynn is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions. She also voices the female Crusader in Diablo III.
The Massive Stinger drops from Kliaa at Bloodthorn Hill in .
Mass Invisibility is a mage class talent, instantly rendering you and your nearby allies invisible. It is an exclusive choice node with Mass Barrier.
Master's Bell drops from the Shade of Medivh in the Return to Karazhan.
